observations.footwork: Fighter bounces on feet, circling laterally while maintaining position in the center-left of the frame
observations.guard: Both hands held high in a boxing guard, elbows tucked, protecting the head and body
observations.upper_body: Slight bobbing and weaving motion, maintaining visual focus on the partner
observations.distance: Close to partner, within striking range, partner partially visible on left edge
observations.notable: Initial preparatory movement, bouncing rhythm, looking for openings

observations.footwork: Aggressive lunge forward, establishing a wide dominant stance during the extension
observations.guard: Left lead hand extends forward, right hand remains back near chin as a counterbalance
observations.upper_body: Leaning into a forward punch, driving through the hips, torso rotates towards the target
observations.distance: Closing distance with partner, reaching out for contact
observations.notable: Explosive burst of action, throwing what appears to be a straight punch or combination

observations.footwork: Recovery step, pulling back weight to reset into a stable neutral stance
observations.guard: Returning to high guard, bringing hands back up to protect the face
observations.upper_body: Recovering from the strike, straightening upright, re-engaging with the partner
observations.distance: Back to normal working distance, moving out of close contact
observations.notable: Transition from aggressive action back to a composed stance, guard reset

movement_events.detail: Lunging forward, leading hand extends for a strike, torso rotates into the punch
Continuing forward momentum, closing the gap between fighter and partner
Retracting the extended hand, pulling back weight to a more defensive crouch
Returning to a full upright guard, reestablishing the base stance and ready position
